description: This Java class defines a sine wave oscillator named SineOscillator, which extends a SawOscillator class. It includes a method to calculate sine values using a Taylor series approximation within a specified range, and a render method that converts the phase into a sine wave output.

classes.name: SineOscillator
classes.description: A class that generates sine wave signals using a Taylor series approximation, extending functionality from SawOscillator.

methods.name: fastSin
methods.description: Calculates sine of the current phase using a Taylor series expansion, efficient for in-range input values.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Overrides render method to produce a sine wave sample based on the current phase and amplitude.
